turns.user_input: Load the roster from data/roster.json and calculate total cap hit and remaining cap space. The salary cap is $255M.
Which 5 players have the worst cap hit relative to their performance grade? Calculate a value score as performance_grade / (cap_hit in millions).
If we cut Kevin Byard and Nate Davis, how much cap space do we save? Factor in dead money - cutting a player accelerates remaining dead money to the current year.

We need $15M in additional cap space to sign a free agent QB. What combination of cuts and/or restructures gets us there with minimal roster damage? Consider cutting low-grade players or restructuring high-salary veterans.
Restructure Montez Sweat's deal: convert $10M of his base salary to signing bonus spread over his 2 remaining years. Calculate the new cap hit per year.
Show me the cap projection for the next 3 years with all the changes we discussed (Byard/Davis cuts and Sweat restructure). Account for the cap increasing by ~$15M per year.
